productConcept.name: Kesslar & Vane
productConcept.description: A precision scientific instrument workshop hand-assembling theodolites, spectrometers, and measuring instruments in Edinburgh since 1887 — each piece numbered, each commission accepted by brief.
productConcept.rationale: The Spun Vellum design system's Cormorant Garamond weight 800 headings, near-black/white palette, and restrained 34px gutter grid demanded a product world of exacting craft and unhurried precision. Precision instruments — theodolites, levels, micrometers, spectrometers — answered the aesthetic signal. The serif weight and tight tracking align with historical instrument-maker type conventions. The Edinburgh address grounds the fiction in a real city with a legitimate clockmaking and instrument-making heritage.
